description: Vendored original-language and comparison sources. Each vendored file is xz-compressed. sha256 = hash of the .xz file in sources/; raw_sha256 = hash of the decompressed content; upstream_sha256 = hash of the downloaded upstream object (zip for eBible). Maintained by scripts/fetch_sources.sh; entries whose status is not 'vendored' are skipped.

entries.notes: Complete A-Omega DjVu OCR. Greek is mostly recognised, but expect occasional Greek->Latin misreads (e.g. 'Bopav' for Βορᾶν), papyrus sigla noise, page headers, and two-column interleaving. Headwords usually stand alone on a line ending with '.' or ','. Entry segmentation must be heuristic.
